title: Anchor harness-hook governance to worktree filesystem

issues.title: Anchor harness-hook governance to worktree filesystem
issues.dod: arm claim requires --worktree, creates/updates worktrees with derived branch names, writes <git-dir>/armature-task-id. Harness hook reads binding from that file (env var fallback), passes through silently when absent or stale, logs pass-throughs. arm merged tears down task/bug worktrees and warns on logged pass-throughs. make check green.
issues.scope: cmd/armature/claim.go, cmd/armature/claim_test.go, cmd/armature/harness_hook.go, cmd/armature/harness_hook_test.go, cmd/armature/merged.go, cmd/armature/merged_test.go, internal/harnesshook/runner.go, internal/harnesshook/runner_test.go

issues.title: Add --worktree to arm claim: create/update worktree and write task binding file
issues.dod: arm claim requires --worktree (error if omitted). Creates worktree + derived branch (feat/<id>, task/<id>, fix/<id>) if path absent; updates <git-dir>/armature-task-id if path exists. Epic returns error. Branch off parent story branch for task/bug. Claim op still appended to ops log.
notes: Branch naming: story/feature → feat/<id>, task → task/<id>, bug → fix/<id>
Binding file path: <git-dir>/armature-task-id (git rev-parse --git-dir inside worktree)
Worktree create: git worktree add <path> <branch>; update path = write binding file only
Task/bug branch off parent story/feature branch, not main

issues.title: Update harness-hook to read binding from file, pass through silently, and log pass-throughs
issues.dod: resolveTaskBinding(gitDir) reads <git-dir>/armature-task-id, falls back to ARMATURE_TASK_ID, returns empty string when absent. Hook passes through (exit 0) when no binding or stale (status != claimed/in-progress). Pass-throughs logged to <git-dir>/armature-hook.log. TestHarnessHookRequiresTaskID inverted to TestHarnessHookPassesThroughWithoutTaskID.
notes: Resolution order: file > env var > empty string (pass-through, exit 0)
Stale detection: load materialized state snapshot, check status; anything != claimed or in-progress is stale
Log line format: <RFC3339 timestamp> <tool-name> <reason> where reason is no-binding or stale:<status>
Log file is under .git/ — never committed, no .gitignore entry needed
Prior art: setupRepoWithTask, runTrls, newRootCmd()+cmd.Execute() in harness_hook_test.go

issues.title: Update arm merged --issue to tear down task/bug worktrees and warn on pass-throughs
issues.dod: arm merged --issue removes git worktree for task-type and bug-type issues via git worktree remove. Reads <git-dir>/armature-hook.log from that worktree before removal; emits warning to stderr if any pass-through entries present. Story/feature issues: no worktree removal.
notes: Read <git-dir>/armature-hook.log before removal; warn to stderr if file exists and non-empty
Story and feature worktrees are not removed by arm merged; coordinator manages their lifecycle
